init_distributed_mode: initialize distributed training mode across multiple GPUs using spawn, SLURM, or environment variable launchers
all_gather_list: gather arbitrary picklable Python data from all distributed workers into a single list
all_reduce_dict: all-reduce a dictionary of tensor and scalar values across distributed workers for aggregated metrics
gather_list_and_concat: gather tensors from all GPUs and concatenate them into a single tensor
get_init_file: create a unique temporary init file in a shared folder for distributed process group initialization
